name: Coin
desc: Hard money, counted into your hand.

name: Herbs
desc: Bundles tied at the stem.

name: Vigor
desc: What your body has left today.

name: Qi
desc: Breath you have gathered and kept.

name: Notes
desc: Loose pages. Every one you keep makes the next reading quicker and gives you somewhere to tuck a coin.

name: Floor
desc: Spans of floor you can put something on.

name: Attunement
desc: How many techniques you can hold ready at once.

name: Carried current
desc: A charge you are carrying to the next place.

name: Lore
desc: What you have read and can call back.

name: Read the almanac
desc: Sit with the pages until something sticks.

name: Gather the breath
desc: Sit and draw until you are full; there is nowhere to put any more.

name: Rest
desc: Sit down until you can work again.

name: Haul sacks
desc: Two vigor for three coin. After the third load the miller rounds the wage up.
flavor: Wen counts every sack you carry.

name: Gather herbs
desc: A trip out to the beds and back.

name: Walk the ridge
desc: A long climb for a long look.

name: A larger pouch
desc: Leather, double-stitched.

name: Marginal notes
desc: You start writing prices in the margins, and every level of Lore you already have widens your purse.

name: Take the ferry road
desc: You leave the barn and the herb beds behind.
warn: The herb beds are half a day behind you after this.

name: Turn back
desc: The road was a mistake.

name: Focus charm
desc: A knot of cord you can hang a second technique on.

name: Hayloft
desc: Straw, a slatted window, and the smell of grain.

name: Lean-to
desc: Your own four walls, nearly.

name: Straw pallet
desc: Better than the bare boards.

name: Rope cot
desc: Off the floor at last.

name: Herb rack
desc: Somewhere to hang what you cut.

name: Ember form
desc: A shape you hold in the breath while you work.
flavor: It is warm, and it wants to be used.

name: Ash form
desc: The same shape, run cold.
warn: Taking up the cold reading settles the shape for good.

name: Kindling form
desc: A reading of the same shape that cannot be held beside the cold one.
warn: Taking up the kindling reading settles the shape for good.

name: Fire adept
title: Fire Adept
desc: Two forms held and used is a standing of sorts.
